blurb: Blackwood Sporting Co. provides a variety of shooting ranges open to the public without reservations. They offer individual and group lessons, license to carry handgun training, and host special events including charity and corporate gatherings. Their facilities include a sporting clay event center and shotgun event center for parties and fundraisers.
